overall_goal: Simmer the curry and stir it occasionally

goals.description: Cover the pan and perform the first stir
goals.rationale: The person covers the pan to let the food simmer, then later lifts the lid to stir the food for the first time and replaces the lid.
The person stirs the simmering food two more times, tapping the spatula to remove residue and replacing the lid each time.

goals.description: Perform the final stir and set the lid aside
goals.rationale: The person lifts the lid, stirs the food again, and sets the lid aside on the chopping board instead of putting it back on the pan.
